# Demo audio rights

The ten audio excerpts in this folder come from *Compositions* (2012), performed by the Airmen of Note, United States Air Force Band. The United States Air Force publishes the album through its Public Domain Music collection. Wikimedia Commons identifies the composition, performance, and recording of each source file as `PD-USGov-Military-Air Force`.

- Source collection: https://www.music.af.mil/Multimedia/Music/Public-Domain-Music/
- Rights rationale: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Template:PD-USGov-Military-Air_Force
- U.S. Government works: https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/17/105
- Per-track source pages, composers, performers, and rights URLs: `manifest.json`

`tests/fixtures/jazz.js` creates the committed 40-second excerpts from those source recordings. The excerpts are public-domain assets in the United States; they are not relicensed under the plugin's GPL license. Copyright status outside the United States may vary.
